---
title: "Relative difference in % between median and mean prices"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# SCB data snapshot committed in data/ (regenerate with fetch_and_tidy_lan_data_api.R)
brf_lan_tidy <- read.csv("data/brf_lan_tidy.csv")
```

```{r}
#Change the df so that it will be displayed in thousant SEK instead + calculate percentage difference. It shows how much higher or lower the mean price is relative to the median.
brf_lan_tidy <- brf_lan_tidy |>
  mutate(mean_price_mkr = mean_price / 1e6,
    median_price_mkr = median_price / 1e6,
    diff_pct = (mean_price_mkr - median_price_mkr) /
      median_price_mkr * 100, 
    diff_direction = ifelse(diff_pct >= 0, "Mean above median", "Mean below median"))
#Arrange the order of the regions after the media price 2025
region_order <- brf_lan_tidy |>
  filter(year == 2025) |>
  arrange(median_price_mkr) |>
  pull(region)
#Apply the new region order
brf_lan_tidy <- brf_lan_tidy |>
    mutate(region = factor(region, levels = region_order)) 
```

```{r}
p_lollipop <- ggplot(brf_lan_tidy, aes(y = region, group = region)) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    #linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "black") +

  geom_segment(aes(
    x = 0, 
    xend = diff_pct, 
    yend = region, 
    frame = year),
    colour = "grey") +
  
  geom_point(aes(
    x = diff_pct, 
    colour = diff_direction,
    frame = year,
    text = paste(region,
           paste("Median:", median_price_mkr, "million SEK"),
           paste("Mean:", mean_price_mkr, "million SEK"),
           paste("Difference:", round(diff_pct), "%"),
           sep = "<br>")), size = 2) +

    labs(title = "Percentage difference between mean and median prices",
    subtitle = "Relative difference in %",
    x = "Difference relative to median (%)",
    y = NULL,
    color = NULL) +

    scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
    "Mean above median" = "steelblue",
    "Mean below median" = "darkorange")) +

    scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-20, 140, 20)) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right")
```

```{r}
ggplotly(p_lollipop, tooltip = "text") |>
  animation_opts(redraw = TRUE)|>
  animation_slider(
    currentvalue = list(
      prefix = "Year: ")) |> 

animation_button(
    visible = FALSE
  )
```
